items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: You know anything about Bachaca? Who? Bachaca. That's what you call it when they swing out.

ctx.x: I mean, swing your partner. Oh. Make me get out there and want to do a little dancing. You know anything about Bachaca? Who? Bachaca. That's what you call it when they swing out. Swing? That's what they call it in Creole.
